RIEN-CADUCEUS_START.title: Caduceus - Start
RIEN-CADUCEUS_START.description:
Current effect: {CaduceusEffect}.
1: Deal 6 damage and gain 6 Block.
2: Deal 6 damage and apply 1 Vulnerable.
3: Deal 6 damage and deal 4 damage to ALL enemies.
RIEN-AS_ORDERED.title: As Ordered
RIEN-AS_ORDERED.description: Deal 2 damage 3 times. Gain 1 Block 3 times.
RIEN-SLASH.title: Slash
RIEN-DOUBLE_SLASH.title: Double Slash
RIEN-COMMAND_TRAJECTORY.title: Command Trajectory
RIEN-COMMAND_TRAJECTORY.description: Deal 10 damage. Remove the target's Strength.
RIEN-MULTI_SLASH.title: Multi Slash
RIEN-MULTI_SLASH.description: Deal 7 damage. Draw 1 card. If your draw pile is Unique, gain 1 Energy.
RIEN-CADUCEUS_OPENING.title: Caduceus - Opening
RIEN-CADUCEUS_OPENING.description:
Current effect: {CaduceusEffect}.
1: Deal 5 damage and gain 5 Thorns.
2: Deal 5 damage, then deal 2 damage twice.
3: Deal 4 damage to ALL enemies twice.
RIEN-CADUCEUS_VERSATILE.title: Caduceus - Versatile
RIEN-CADUCEUS_VERSATILE.description:
Current effect: {CaduceusEffect}. Repeat the selected effect X times.
1: Deal 1 damage and gain 9 Block.
2: Deal 5 damage and gain 5 Block.
3: Deal 9 damage and gain 1 Block.
RIEN-DEBT.title: Debt
RIEN-COERCION.title: Coercion
RIEN-COERCION.description: Deal 8 damage. If the target has Block, hit it twice.
RIEN-UNIQUE_STRIKE.title: Unique Strike
RIEN-UNIQUE_STRIKE.description: Deal 10 damage. If your draw pile is Unique, draw 2 cards.
RIEN-PREPARE.title: Prepare
RIEN-PREPARE.description: Gain 2 Block. Gain 2 Energy at the start of your next turn.
RIEN-ENGAGE.title: Engage
RIEN-ENGAGE.description: Draw 2 cards. Draw 2 additional cards at the start of your next turn.
RIEN-REDEPLOY.title: Redeploy
RIEN-REDEPLOY.description: Choose up to 2 cards in your draw pile. Put them into your discard pile.
RIEN-SACRIFICIAL_DEFENSE.title: Sacrificial Defense
RIEN-TEMPORARY_COMMAND.title: Temporary Command
RIEN-TEMPORARY_COMMAND.description: Gain 1 Command's Protection until the end of this turn.
RIEN-UNIQUE_DEFENSE.title: Unique Defense
RIEN-UNIQUE_DEFENSE.description: Gain 8 Block. If your draw pile is Unique, reduce the target's Strength by 3 until the end of this turn.
RIEN-CADUCEUS_PREPARATION.title: Caduceus - Preparation
RIEN-CADUCEUS_PREPARATION.description:
Current effect: {CaduceusEffect}.
1: Lose 5 HP, heal 3 HP, and deal 16 damage.
2: Deal 14 damage.
3: Deal 3 damage and gain 1 Command's Protection.
RIEN-STAB.title: Stab
RIEN-STAB.description: Deal 15 damage. Reduce the target's Strength by 2 and apply 1 Weak.
RIEN-UNIQUE_SWORD_DANCE.title: Unique Sword Dance
RIEN-UNIQUE_SWORD_DANCE.description: Deal 13 damage to ALL enemies. If your draw pile is Unique, hit twice.
RIEN-CITYS_WILL.title: City's Will
RIEN-CITYS_WILL.description: Deal 8 damage. Gain 8 Block. Draw 1 card. If your draw pile is Unique, gain 1 Energy.
RIEN-CADUCEUS_PLAN.title: Caduceus - Plan
RIEN-CADUCEUS_PLAN.description: Deal 15 damage. The next Caduceus card you play costs 0.
RIEN-FINISHER.title: Finisher
RIEN-FINISHER.description: Deal 20 damage. Costs 1 less for each Caduceus card played this combat.
RIEN-MEANING_OF_COMMAND.title: Meaning of Command
RIEN-MEANING_OF_COMMAND.description: Deal 20 damage. Draw 3 cards. If your draw pile is Unique, gain 2 Energy.
RIEN-CADUCEUS_DEFENSE.title: Caduceus - Defense
RIEN-CADUCEUS_DEFENSE.description:
Current effect: {CaduceusEffect}.
1: Gain 11 Block.
2: Lose 5 HP, heal 3 HP, and gain 18 Block.
3: Gain 5 Block and apply 2 Weak to yourself.
RIEN-CADUCEUS_LINK.title: Caduceus - Link
RIEN-CADUCEUS_LINK.description:
Current effect: {CaduceusEffect}.
1: Draw 4 cards.
2: Apply 2 Vulnerable and 2 Weak to ALL enemies.
3: Gain 3 Block and 1 Command's Protection.
RIEN-PERFORM.title: Perform
RIEN-PERFORM.description: Gain Block equal to your Command's Protection + 3.
RIEN-REPEATING_COMMAND.title: Repeating Command
RIEN-PANIC_RECOVERY.title: Panic Recovery
RIEN-PANIC_RECOVERY.description: Reduce your Vulnerable, Weak, and Frail by 4.
RIEN-READY_STANCE.title: Ready Stance
RIEN-READY_STANCE.description: Choose up to 3 cards in your draw pile to Exhaust. Draw 1 card.
RIEN-COMMAND_GUARD.title: Command - Guard
RIEN-COMMAND_GUARD.description: Whenever you complete a command, gain 10 Block.
RIEN-COMMAND_ACCELERATION.title: Command - Acceleration
RIEN-COMMAND_ACCELERATION.description: Whenever you complete a command, draw 2 cards.
RIEN-COMMAND_FULFILLMENT.title: Command - Fulfillment
RIEN-COMMAND_FULFILLMENT.description: Whenever you complete a command, gain 1 Energy next turn.
RIEN-RESOLVE.title: Resolve
RIEN-RESOLVE.description: Increase your damage by 10% for each stack of Command's Protection.
RIEN-TORRENT.title: Torrent
RIEN-TORRENT.description: Whenever you trigger Unique, draw 1 card.
RIEN-UNLOCKED_WEAPON.title: Unlocked Weapon
RIEN-UNLOCKED_WEAPON.description: Whenever your draw pile is shuffled, put up to 5 cards into your discard pile.
RIEN-INDEPENDENT_DEFENSE.title: Independent Defense
RIEN-INDEPENDENT_DEFENSE.description: At the end of your turn, if your draw pile is Unique, gain 10 Block.
RIEN-FURIOSO_REPLICA.title: Furioso - Replica
RIEN-FURIOSO_REPLICA.description: Deal 30 damage and apply 3 Vulnerable. Reduce the target's Strength by 5 this turn. If your deck has at least 5 Caduceus cards, add Furioso - Crescendo to your hand.
RIEN-CADUCEUS_STRATEGY.title: Caduceus - Strategy
RIEN-CADUCEUS_STRATEGY.description:
Current effect: {CaduceusEffect}.
1: Deal 14 damage.
2: Deal 1 damage and gain 12 Block.
3: Deal 1 damage, gain 1 Energy, and draw 1 card.
RIEN-FURIOSO_CRESCENDO.title: Furioso - Crescendo
RIEN-FURIOSO_CRESCENDO.description: Deal 30 damage to ALL enemies. Gain 30 Block.
RIEN-COMMAND_GUIDANCE.title: Command Guidance
RIEN-COMMAND_GUIDANCE.description: Spend up to 3 Command's Protection. Gain that much Energy, draw that many cards, and gain that much Block.
RIEN-COMMAND_PROTECTION.title: Command's Protection
RIEN-COMMAND_PROTECTION.description: Spend your Command's Protection. Gain Block equal to 9 times the amount spent. Heal 5 HP.
RIEN-FAITH.title: Faith
RIEN-FAITH.description: Draw X cards. Those cards cost X less.
RIEN-COMMAND_GUIDANCE_FORM.title: Command-Given Form
RIEN-COMMAND_GUIDANCE_FORM.description: At the start of each turn, gain 1 Command's Protection.
RIEN-PERSONALITY_OPENING_PASSIVE_RESISTA: Terminal effects no longer trigger at the start of your turn. Convert all Command's Protection into Bloom.
RIEN-CADUCEUS_END.title: Caduceus - End
RIEN-CADUCEUS_END.description:
Choose one effect to trigger at the end of combat:
1: Heal 10 HP.
2: Gain 2 Energy Potions.
3: Upgrade 1 random card in your deck.
RIEN-CONTINUAL_COMMAND.title: Continual Command
RIEN-CONTINUAL_COMMAND.description: At the start of your turn, complete your command 1 additional time.
RIEN-FIRST_CARD_UNIQUE.title: Command's Meaning
RIEN-FIRST_CARD_UNIQUE.description: The first card you play each turn triggers Unique.
RIEN-PREDICTABLE_FUTURE.title: Predictable Future
RIEN-PREDICTABLE_FUTURE.description: Choose a Caduceus - Strategy effect and activate it immediately.
